National research fellowship scheme administered by Royal Society Te Aparangi on behalf of MBIE. The fellowship is held by the early-career researcher at a host research organisation of their choosing (application requires a Host support template and host-organisation registration); no supervising professor is attached to the scheme itself. The Mana Tuapapa selection panel members (e.g. Prof Renwick Dobson, Prof Cate Macinnis-Ng) are panellists, not supervisors. Official scheme contact: tawhia@royalsociety.org.nz.
